ineq.raw:
(!c. ineq [] c <=> c)
    /\ (!a x b xs c. ineq (CONS (a,x,b) xs) c <=> a <= x /\ x <= b ==> ineq xs c)

cone.raw: cone v S:real^A->bool = affsign sgn_ge {v} S

cone0.raw: cone0 v S:real^A->bool = affsign sgn_gt {v} S

voronoi_open.raw: voronoi_open S (v:real^N) = { x | !w. ((S w) /\ ~(w=v)) ==> (dist( x, v) < dist( x, w)) }

voronoi_closed.raw: voronoi_closed S (v:real^N) = { x | !w. S w ==> (dist( x, v) <= dist( x, w)) }

VORONOI_SET.raw: voronoi_set V W = INTERS { voronoi_closed V (v:real^3) |  v IN W}

VORONOI_NONDG.raw:
voronoi_nondg V ul =
  ((LENGTH ul < 5) /\ (set_of_list ul SUBSET V) /\
     (aff_dim (voronoi_list V ul) + &(LENGTH ul) = &4))
VORONOI_NONDG.reason: reference/flyspeck/text_formalization/general/sphere.hl:316: cannot tokenize at ...aff_dim (voronoi_list V ul) + &(LENGTH ul) = &4))

ROGERS.raw:
!V ul.  rogers V ul =
  convex hull (IMAGE (omega_list_n V ul) {  j |    j  < LENGTH ul })

plane.raw: plane x = (?(u:real^N) v w. ~(collinear {u,v,w}) /\ (x = affine hull {u,v,w}))

closed_half_space.raw: closed_half_space x = (?u v w w'. ~(coplanar {u,v,w,w'}) /\ (x = aff_ge {u,v,w} {w'}))

open_half_space.raw: open_half_space x = (?u v w w'. ~(coplanar {u,v,w,w'}) /\ (x = aff_gt {u,v,w} {w'}))

orientation.raw: orientation S v sgn = affsign sgn (S DIFF {v}) {v} (circumcenter S)

cyclic_set.raw:
cyclic_set W v w =
     (~(v=w) /\ (FINITE W) /\ (!p q h. W p /\ W q /\ (p = q + h % (v - w)) ==> (p=q)) /\
        (W INTER (affine hull {v,w}) = EMPTY))

azim_cycle.raw:
azim_cycle W v w p =
   if (W SUBSET {p}) then p else
    (@u. ~(u=p) /\ W u /\
      (!q.  ~(q=p) /\ W q ==>
          (azim v w p u < azim v w p q) \/
          ((azim v w p u = azim v w p q) /\
             (norm (projection (w-v) (u-v)) <= norm (projection (w-v) (q-v))))))

c_cone.raw: c_cone (v,w:real^3, r:real)={x:real^3 | ((x-v) dot w = norm (x-v)* norm w* r)}

rconesgn.raw: rconesgn sgn v w h = {x:real^A | sgn ((x-v) dot (w-v)) (dist(x,v)*dist(w,v)*h)}

scale.raw: scale (t:real^3) (u:real^3) = vector[t$1 * u$1; t$2 * u$2; t$3 * u$3]

ortho0.raw: ortho0 x v1 v2 v3 = conv0 {x,x+v1,x+v1+v2,x+v1+v2+v3}

make_point.raw: make_point v1 v2 v3 w r1 r2 r3 = @v. (aff_ge {v1,v2,v3} {w} (v:real^3)) /\ (r1 = dist(v1,v)) /\ (r2 = dist(v2,v)) /\ (r3 = dist(v3,v))

abc_param.raw:
abc_param v0 v1 v2 c =
    let a = (&1/(&2)) * dist(v0,v1) in
    let b = radV {v0,v1,v2} in
     (a,b,c)

subat.raw:
subat (i:num) (y:A) ([]:(A)list) = ([]:(A)list) /\
   subat i (y:A) (x::xs) = if i = 0 then y ::  xs else x :: (subat (i-1) y xs)
